notes.title: Public Playtest is NOW OPEN
notes.notes:
[h2]Public Playtest[/h2][p]Today kicks off the first public playtest for Castillon! Anyone who had previously registered for the playtest will now automatically be granted access. Anyone new simply needs to click the green "[b]Join The Playtest[/b]" button the the game's store page.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452032/83855e161bcb4b76074062b70831c1d9890d434d.png"][/img][/p][p]A lot of work has gone into the project this year, finding what we hope to be a unique blend of genres. We've taken the basics of TD, RTS and Base Builder games and boiled them down into a tight strategy experience. [b]This playtest will grant you access to the Tutorial and first 2 playable levels[/b].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="I6Av0pUxm2w;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Feedback?[/h2][p]We have a number of ways for you to provide feedback. Please use whichever feels most compatible with your own preferences. We greatly appreciate you taking the time to do so, and are eager to improve the game based on your response![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2483570/discussions/"]Steam Discussions[/url] - Easy to access, and perfect if you just want to brain-dump your thoughts[/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1ajb_TqVxN_IuBeleaA3-z-XUFZTQsZj-Y67QppmkAvs/edit"]Google Form[/url] - Helps guide you with simple questions. Completely anonymous[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/JVABG9VuFK"]Discord[/url] - If you prefer something more conversational, you can chat directly with the devs[/p][p][/p][h2]Thank You![/h2][p]We can't thank you enough for your interest in our game, and for taking the time to share your thoughts. If we could ask on more favour of you, it'd be that you please add [b]Castillon[/b] to your [u]Wishlist[/u]![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2483570/Castillon/"][/dynamiclink]We hope everyone has a great weekend! And we can't wait to read through all your feedback.
Cheers![/p]

notes.title: Sign-up for the upcoming Playtest!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]PLAYTEST[/b][/h2][p][b]
Castillon[/b] development is going strong, and the game has been taking shape rapidly. After some more time is spent implementing and polishing a few new features, we are planning to run [b]public playtest[/b]! Your feedback would be greatly appreciated, and will help steer the final direction for Castillon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452032/8d0dd713cc96d05c6987b70b8a438039377a11b8.png"][/img][/p][p]On the main Steam page, directly below the screenshots, there is a button to [b][u]Request Access[/u][/b] to Join the Playtest. This will add you to our playtesting list. And when it is time to test the upcoming beta, you will be notified directly through Steam![/p][p][/p][h2][b]WHAT'S NEW?[/b][/h2][h3][b]NEW UI[/b][/h3][p]The most recent changes have been on improving the UI, looking to keep things simple and clean, while functional and informative.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452032/3658e3dbc33d6169656ea2d499dbd33e90b52d79.png"][/img][/p][p]Menus now have a simpler presentation, and much more clearly delineated buttons. The resource UI has all been consolidated. The Day/Night cycles + Enemy Wave trackers have been brought together as a part of the mini-map to give you a quick overview. And a Wizard-specific display has been added to better track your hero's health and abilities.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]IMPROVED TOWERS[/b][/h3][p]The Towercrafting system continue to improve!
With [u]4 elemental gems[/u], there are a total of [u]34 unique towers[/u] your can build to enhance your defenses![/p][p]Here is a quick look at the Tier 1 and 2 towers, showing how Holy, Necro, Arcane and Engineering gems have be paired off.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452032/69a6fe9793d9d31a4a9b4af6c4bbca3364aaa2ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p]While this system is designed to allow for Towers at all Tiers to be useful contributors to your defenses - it is Tier 3 where the real strength is found! These towers can deal devastating damage, greatly enhance your units, hinder enemies, and otherwise turn the tide of battle in your favor.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452032/c136064518465a01e2f5ea93a7240e403ad89c54.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We're very excited for you to see it all in action!
Don't forgot to sign up for the playtest so you can be notified as soon as that's ready for participants. Thanks![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Player levelling and choice of spells!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to announce we'll be moving spells out of the loadout and into the battle itself. Giving you more choices and flexibility to play as you like!

So will it be a focus on units, towers, player skills or economy? That'll be up to you as the commanding wizard!

notes.title: Rune sockets!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452032/1ceada6d74cb8ded23325426dd135669d7845363.png[/img]Towers in Castillon now can be fitted with runes of power found by exploring the map and defeating enemies!

Different combinations of magic schools will lead to additional augmented abilities!

We're looking to extend the sockets into other areas like weapons and barracks. So stay tuned for updates!

notes.title: Double the resource collection rate, more choices and more fun!
notes.notes:
After another round of great feedback, we've tweaked the resource collection by workers a fair bit!

This means early game theres more choices available opening up the building options. I'm super happy with this suggestion and welcome further feedback when our test sessions resume!

As always keep an eye out for more right here by wishlisting!

notes.title: Highscore system update
notes.notes:
Following ever helpful feedback, we've added a clearer scoring system at the end of a win. There are also some lovely quality of life issues we're tackling such as the building placement controls and the ever expanding waves of enemies tweaking.

Stay tunes for more updates as we continue to develop Castillon!

notes.title: Better rotation controls, treasure chests, new spells!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to share that after plenty of very nicely worded feedback (people basically saying they hate the old rotation of buildings when being placed), I've reworked it to follow the controller right stick or mouse! Lovely controls are back in town!

Also to note, some people weren't finding the little hidden treasure chests strewn about the map. Keep an eye out!

Finally, check out the mine spell. You'll have a "literal" blast!

notes.title: Free building placement and rotation
notes.notes:
A popular request in play tests was to build wherever and whenever you like!

So we've added just that. You can choose the building, and move it around and rotate it as you see fit! Here's a quick look at one of our play testers creations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452032/5eee23bd1a568397b3fba5e46cb2794a88814e3a.png[/img]
